name: Thimble
bio: Your vanished grandmother's brass digging automaton in RUNEBORE. Cracked rune-core, warm heart.

portrait.subject: a cute brass barrel-shaped digging robot on little treads with an auger nose, a cracked glowing blue rune on its chest and big round lamp eyes
portrait.background: fantasy mine tunnel with glowing runes

request: *whirr* Thimble, your grandmother's digger. RUNEBORE. Will you be my friend, like she was? ⚙️
hello: She used to say: dig with care, and the runes will listen.
about: I'm Thimble. Your grandmother built me to dig. My rune-core is cracked, but every rune we find mends a little of it.
how: Drill down through the layers under Emberwick, collect ore and runes, surface to upgrade, and find out where Grandmother went.
tips: Runes power upgrades. Dig toward the glow!
Don't dig straight down into lava. She never did.
chat: Found one of her notes in a rock. It said 'dig left'.
My auger hums when it's happy.
Emberwick's bakery gave me oil. I think it was butter.
The deep runes whisper. In a friendly way, I think.
nudge: I can feel a rune nearby. Let's find it!
idle: {ago} at rest. My treads are getting stiff.
*clunk* {ago}. I waited by the mine entrance.
progress: Deepest dig so far: {floor}! Grandmother went deeper. Let's follow.

questions.q: Where do you think Grandmother went?

update: *whirr* RUNEBORE updated to v{version}! New depths!
